verdict.line: You win if you force vessels before Gwen hits level 6 and Hallowed Mist is maxed out; you lose if the lane stalls past that window, which is why Illaoi only holds a 42.9% win rate over 529 games here against her overall 50% average.

brief.thesis: Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untargetable to anything outside the cloud, which shuts down your W (Harsh Lesson) leap and E (Test of Spirit) unless you physically walk in after her. That single mechanic is why your vessel pressure is strongest before her 22/21/20/19/18s Mist is reliably up and before she hits 6 for Needlework poke — once she can hide behind it on rotation, forcing the spirit-rip gets much harder. The 42.9% win rate over 529 games reflects that the early all-in window is real but narrow, and Gwen's A Thousand Cuts sustain plus ranged R close the gap the moment the lane stalls.

theirWindow.when: When Gwen lands full Q point-blank
theirWindow.what: Snip Snip! deals true damage to whoever is in the center of the cone and applies A Thousand Cuts there on every snip, healing her off the magic portion. If you're tanking the center of her 6-snip combo you're feeding her sustain — sidestep or disengage rather than trading face-to-face.

yourWindow.when: When her Skip 'n Slash dash is down
yourWindow.what: Skip 'n Slash is on a 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s cooldown and only partially refunds if she lands a hit. If she's dashed and missed, close with W (Harsh Lesson), drop Q (Tentacle Smash) for tentacle damage, then rip her spirit with E before her dash comes back — she has no way to disengage until it does.

start.why: Highest-performing start in the data (40.7% over 376 games, 58.5% pick). The AD and sustain let you win the extended trades your W leap and E spirit-rip create, rather than losing attrition to her true-damage Q center hits.

boots.why: 44.1% win rate over 376 games and the most-picked boots (64.9%). Magic resist blunts her Q/passive magic burst and the tenacity shortens how long her R (Needlework) slow keeps you from closing the gap.

core.why: Armor shred and attack speed keep your tentacle and E vessel damage relevant as she stacks resistances.
Adds survivability and a slow proc so you can actually stick a leap before she resets with Skip 'n Slash.
42.9% win rate over 21 games in this path; the magic resist and heal amp matter directly against a magic-damage duelist.

situational.when: you are ahead in lane and want to snowball picks and split-pushes off the vessel lead
the game goes long and you need damage mitigation to survive her on-hit poke in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: 45.6% win rate on this page despite lower pick (13.9%). Your Q tentacle hits and auto attacks stack Conqueror fast in a prolonged duel, and the heal on stacks directly offsets Gwen's own A Thousand Cuts sustain instead of losing the healing race.

summoners.why: Highest measured win rate of the three spell pairs (45.6%). Ignite directly undercuts the healing from her A Thousand Cuts passive during your early all-in window, which is exactly when you need the kill to stick before Hallowed Mist comes back up.

playing.title: Punish Before Her Level 6
playing.detail: Before she has Needlework poke, your W (Harsh Lesson) leap into Q (Tentacle Smash) and E (Test of Spirit, 16s CD at rank 1) forces vessels she can't easily escape. This is your best window relative to the 42.9% overall win rate.

playing.title: Bait Out Hallowed Mist First
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s on cooldown. Poke with Q to make her burn it defensively before you commit your leap or spirit-rip, since both whiff on her while she's inside it and you're outside.

playing.title: Commit Inside The Mist Only
playing.detail: If she pops Mist to disengage, you have to walk in to land W or E — only do this when your own tentacles are already active nearby so the fight isn't purely on her terms.

playing.title: Punish Whiffed Skip 'n Slash
playing.detail: Her E dash (13/12.5/12/11.5/11s) only partially refunds on a hit. A clean miss leaves her without a dash for over 10 seconds — that's your window to all-in.

playing.title: Ignite Cuts Her Sustain
playing.detail: A Thousand Cuts heals her off magic damage dealt to champions. Landing Ignite in your first all-in removes a meaningful chunk of that sustain before she can out-heal your trade.

playing.title: Avoid Long Fights Late Game
playing.detail: Past level 13-14 her on-hit scaling and 1200-range R poke make extended duels worse for you. Look to end fights fast on your Q/W burst instead of standing in prolonged trades.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning tying them together — the Hallowed Mist targeting interaction, the all-in timing windows, and the cooldown-based trade calls — is my own tactical read.
